title: Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.Requirements Timezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this differentAt most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Project Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About the CompanyFraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.  What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Support Specialist em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About us:Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire, high-impact position designed for a support professional who views every interaction as an opportunity to build a relationship. As a Customer Support Specialist, you are the primary face and voice of Smarter Contact across our multiple support channels.Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. You are not just closing tickets, you are solving complex SMS delivery issues, guiding customers through compliance requirements, and ensuring every interaction is handled with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.As a frontline representative of the company, you are uniquely positioned to identify customer needs and opportunities to improve retention and account growth. You will help surface opportunities for plan upgrades and add-ons while serving as a first line of defence against churn by identifying customer friction early, escalating issues appropriately, and partnering closely with Success and Product teams to help customers stay successful and engaged.What You'll Own: Provide high-quality assistance through real-time chat, emails and phone calls, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels. Consistently maintain a CSAT score of over 85% while meeting targets for response times and resolution speed. Achieve monthly revenue quotas by identifying and closing plan upgrades during customer interactions. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chats, calls, and tasks within the CRM to ensure team-wide visibility. Identify early warning signs like frustration or delivery issues during live chats and resolve them to protect account health. Reinforce the Smarter Contact value proposition and competitive edge in every customer conversation. Capture and relay frontline insights regarding bugs, UX friction, and feature requests to the Product and Leadership teams. Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 8 AM - 8 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to FridayWhat We're Looking For: 4+ years of experience in Customer Support or CX within a B2B SaaS environment, handling high-volume chat and phone queues. 2+ years of experience supporting US-based customers. Excellent written and verbal communication skills;  able to de-escalate, explain complex issues clearly, and drive resolution Proficient or native-level English (full business fluency) A proven track record of identifying expansion opportunities and meeting revenue targets Highly accountable to metrics, with a focus on maintaining consistent KPI improvement. Extremely organized and detail-oriented, ensuring 100% CRM hygiene and adherence to team playbooks/SOPs. Ability to remain composed, professional, and efficient in a fast-paced, high-pressure support environment. Strong business awareness;  able to identify retention risks and expansion opportunities during support interactions A coachable team player who proactively shares frontline feedback to help improve the product and the support process.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer support experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Support Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Bi Operations Specialist
description:

Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the\ "last mile\" of data-managinguser feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the\ "boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations. Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions. Responsibilities User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve  Required Experience Excellent written and verbal English communication skills 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc Experience working with AWS Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools  Preferred Experience Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence Familiarity with the yard management industry Awareness of logistics and supply chain management  Additional Information Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP  About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista De Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade Também Para Pcd♿ em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Servicenow
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Desenvolvedor(A) Servicenow em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Já pensou em Somar no CSC de um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil?  Somos o UltraCSC+, um Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas criado para facilitar a gestão do dia a dia das empresas do Grupo Ultra, promovendo mais eficiência e produtividade em processos transacionais.    Você soma com nosso crescimento!   Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe.    Sobre a área    Atuar como  referência técnica e funcional da plataforma ServiceNow  , sendo responsável pela sustentação avançada, evolução contínua e governança da solução, assegurando alta disponibilidade, qualidade dos serviços e aderência aos processos de Gestão de Serviços de TI (ITSM).   O profissional atua de forma autônoma e consultiva, liderando tecnicamente demandas de média e alta complexidade, desenvolvimentos no  ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code  , automações de workflows, integrações e iniciativas de  automação e uso responsável de Inteligência Artificial  , garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas, requisitos de auditoria, segurança da informação e boas práticas de mercado (ITIL).    No seu dia a dia você focará em:    Sustentação e Operação ITSM    Atuar de forma sênior na sustentação da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho, disponibilidade e qualidade das entregas;    Atuar nos processos de  Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD) , assegurando correta execução, priorização, categorização, registro e encerramento;    Atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico para chamados de maior complexidade.    Evolução da Plataforma e Desenvolvimento    Desenvolver, evoluir e manter soluções utilizando  ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code;     Atuar com Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies e Catalog Items  , garantindo aderência às boas práticas da plataforma;    Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais de mudanças, releases, upgrades e novas funcionalidades;    Conduzir e revisar testes técnicos e funcionais, garantindo qualidade antes de implantações em produção.    Análise, Melhoria Contínua e Governança    Conduzir  análises de causa raiz (RCA) , propondo e implementando soluções definitivas para incidentes recorrentes.   Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos, dados e fluxos da plataforma;    Garantir aderência a  controles internos, auditorias, compliance e segurança da informação.     Integrações, Automação e IA    Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de  integrações entre ServiceNow e sistemas corporativos  , utilizando  IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP;     Liderar iniciativas de  automação de processos e workflows  , reduzindo atividades manuais e aumentando eficiência operacional;    Utilizar e orientar o uso de  recursos de Inteligência Artificial e automação   (ex.: Virtual Agent, assistentes, sugestões automáticas), garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade, privacidade e segurança.    Relacionamento, Comunicação e Liderança Técnica    Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, fornecedores e consultorias, entendendo necessidades e traduzindo em soluções técnicas;    Atuar como  referência técnica   para analistas juniores e plenos, apoiando no desenvolvimento técnico da equipe;    Garantir documentação técnica e funcional completa e atualizada (processos, integrações, manuais e registros de mudanças).     Para esta posição procuramos talentos que tenham:    ServiceNow (Avançado):   sustentação, administração e evolução da plataforma;    ITSM:   domínio dos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD);    ServiceNowApp Engine / Low-Code (Avançado):   desenvolvimento e customizações;    Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts e UI Policies;     Integrações:   experiência com IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP;    ITIL:   sólidos conhecimentos aplicados à operação e melhoria contínua;    Governançae Compliance:   atuação em ambientes corporativos com auditorias e controles internos;    Automação e IA:   experiência prática ou liderança técnica em iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de IA na plataforma;    Certificações:   Trilha CSA (Certified ServiceNow Administrator);    Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;    Visão sistêmica e pensamento analítico;    Autonomia, responsabilidade técnica e senso de dono;    Comunicação clara, postura consultiva e relacionamento interpessoal;    Capacidade deatuar como referência técnica e mentor;    Organização, foco em qualidade, governança e melhoria contínua.     Oferecemos uma proposta de remuneração fixa e variável competitiva, além de uma série de benefícios, veja alguns deles:    Plano de saúde   Plano odontológico   VA e VR valores competitivos com o mercado   Auxílio Farmácia   Licença familiar e Kit Ultra Família, 180 dias para licença maternidade e 20 dias para licença paternidade. Kit para mãe e bebê   Auxílio Creche 24 meses de reembolso para mães e pais   Auxílio ao filho com deficiência   Gympass   Previdência Privada   Programa de Pós-graduação e Idiomas e parcerias educacionais   Programas de saúde e bem-estar, quick-massage e ginastica laboral

Registrar, acompanhar e tratar não conformidades relacionadas ao atendimento, propondo ajustes de processo ou conduta;    Atualizar e padronizar scripts de atendimento e fluxos internos, buscando produtividade e qualidade;    Participar dereuniões de resultado com clientes e Diretoria;    Elaborar planos de ação para indicadores com baixa performance.    2. title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore) Role Summary We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance. Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.  Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.  Technical Requirements ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:

Linux Systems EngineerEmbedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot.04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed forAPPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Emerging Market Trader em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Quem somos?Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer:A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo:Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente:Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido:Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro:Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1:Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito:A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação: Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração: Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados: Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend: Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança: Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps: Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe:Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação:Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas:Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia:Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa. Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de3+ anosem desenvolvimento de software;  Experiência de2+ anos com Node.Js e TypeScriptem produção Experiência de1+ anos com PHPem produção;  Experiência de2+ anos com Tecnologias Webem produção;  Experiência de2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;  Experiência com filas emensageria (RabbitMQ);  Conhecimento de frameworks modernos comoNestJSe/ou Next.Js;  Conhecimento em padrõesde arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);  Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código;  Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);  Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa. Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;  Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);  Conhecimento prático naintegração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents. O que oferecemos? Liderar a estratégia, priorização e evolução do produto, conectando necessidades de cliente, operação, tecnologia e objetivos de negócio;  Conduzir processos contínuos de discovery para identificar oportunidades de receita, eficiência operacional, redução de atritos e melhoria da experiência do cliente;  Definir, acompanhar e evoluir métricas de produto, negócio e operação, orientando decisões com base em dados e promovendo entregas de alto impacto;  Construir e comunicar visão, estratégia, roadmap, árvores de métricas, hipóteses, experimentos e memos executivos que deem clareza sobre prioridades, trade-offs e investimentos;  Promover alinhamento entre áreas de negócio, operação, dados, design e tecnologia, garantindo entendimento comum sobre objetivos, impactos e dependências;  Atuar como elo entre ostimes, facilitando colaboração, comunicação efetiva e ritmo sustentável de execução;  Impulsionar a melhoria contínua do produto e da disciplina de produto, contribuindo para a evolução da maturidade da área.O que é preciso para fazer parte do time? Sólida experiência em gestão de produtos digitais, preferencialmente em contextos complexos, com forte interface com operação e eficiência operacional. Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento estruturado, com habilidade para transformar problemas, dados e hipóteses em decisões de produto e priorização. Domínio de métricas de produto, negócio e operação, como adoção, engajamento, satisfação, retenção, conversão, eficiência, qualidade, confiabilidade e performance. Vivência com discovery e validação de soluções, utilizando pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas, prototipagem, testes e experimentação. Experiência na definição e acompanhamento de OKRs, KPIs e indicadores de impacto. Capacidade de priorizar com clareza, considerando valor, esforço, risco, dependências e impacto para cliente, operação e negócio. Boa base de UX, pesquisa e design de interação, com capacidade de transformar insights em evolução de jornada e de experiência. Vivência com práticas de melhoria contínua e gestão de fluxo, como Lean, A3, PDCA, Kaizen e refinement. Conhecimento intermediário de IA aplicada a produtos digitais, com capacidade de identificar casos de uso para automações, copilots e agentes, estruturar experimentos, definir métricas de adoção e qualidade, e trabalhar em conjunto com times técnicos na evolução dessas soluções. Formação superior desejável em Tecnologia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.Será um diferencial se você: Experiência com produtos de plataforma, produtos internos, APIs, integrações e arquitetura orientada a eventos. Familiaridade com ambientes cloud, especialmente Microsoft Azure, com foco em dados, integração, monitoramento e observabilidade. Vivência prática com agentes, skills, orquestração de ferramentas, telemetria e avaliação de soluções baseadas em IA. Autonomia com ferramentas analíticas, dashboards e consultas em dados para investigação e tomada de decisão. Experiência em contextos que exijam conciliar escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança e experiência do usuário.A NOSSA EVOLUÇÃO É CRESCENTE! E, para acompanhar esse crescimento, precisamos de pessoas que agreguem propondo ideias, soluções e desafios! Gostou da oportunidade? Vamos juntos e faça parte da nossa história! #vempraframe

title: Consultor(A) Comercial
description:

Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.   Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.  Quem somos e o que fazemos   Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.  Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.  O que oferecemos   Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;  Modelo de trabalho híbrido;  Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;  Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;  Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;  Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;  Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.   Suas responsabilidades   Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:  Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ;  Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;  Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;  Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;  Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;  Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;  Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;  Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.    Quem procuramos   Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:  Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;  Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;  Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;  Habilidade paraconstruir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;  Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório. Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;  Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;  Graduação completa;  Inglês avançado.   Nosso compromisso com a diversidade   Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.  Faça parte da nossa história   Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Gerente De Operações Da Mentoria
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Gerente De Operações Da Mentoria em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o Grupo Escalada   Somos um ecossistema com diversas soluções para empresas que desejam vender os seus produtos na internet ou que já vendem e querem aumentar os seus resultados. Nosso propósito é transformar o comércio digital no Brasil. Aqui, valorizamos inovação, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e pessoas com brilho nos olhos.    Representada por  Dhiego Rosa – Instagram: @dhiegorosa e YouTube: dhiegorosa   – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.    Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre, destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina.   O que buscamos:    Buscamos um(a)  Gerente de Operações da Mentoria   para liderar e estruturar a operação da nossa principal linha de negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, padronização de processos, qualidade na entrega e desenvolvimento da equipe.   Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico e analítico, alta capacidade de gestão, autonomia para tomada de decisão e experiência em operações escaláveis, capaz de atuar diretamente na evolução da experiência dos mentorados e crescimento sustentável da área.    Responsabilidades:    Liderar equipe de mentores, supervisores e suporte, acompanhando performance, desenvolvimento e estruturação do time;    Garantir qualidade e consistência da operação de mentoria, assegurando padronização de processos, entregas e experiência do cliente;    Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos operacionais, metodologias e processos internos;    Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais, como NPS, churn, engajamento, capacidade operacional e satisfação dos mentorados;    Realizar gestão de crises, tratativas de casos críticos, conflitos e demandas sensíveis de clientes;    Planejar capacidade operacional da equipe, onboarding e desenvolvimento de novos mentores;    Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, RH, Financeiro, Marketing e Produto.    Requisitos:    Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas;    Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de operações, customer success, consultoria, educação executiva ou áreas correlatas;    Experiência comprovada em estruturação de processos, padronização de entrega e gestão por indicadores em empresas de serviço continuado, como educação executiva, consultoria, mentoria, treinamento corporativo, SaaS B2B ou customer success de alto contato;    Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes operacionais de médio/grande porte;    Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento de performance, incluindo OKRs, KPIs, dashboards gerenciais, CRM e plataformas de operação digital;    Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e implementação de melhorias contínuas;    Capacidade demonstrável de atuar com autonomia, senso de dono e reporte de resultados, sem dependência de direcionamento constante;    Perfil analítico, organizado, resiliente e com forte capacidade de liderança;    Vivência em operações escaláveis e ambientes de crescimento acelerado.     Diferenciais:    Experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, educação online ou consultorias;    Conhecimento em e-commerce, marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee) e comércio digital;    Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento, scale-ups ou operações com ticket elevado;    Vivência empreendedora ou passagem por empresas em fase de crescimento acelerado, com familiaridade em ambientes dinâmicos, alta autonomia e processos em estruturação;    Compreensão da realidade do pequeno e médio empreendedor brasileiro, incluindo desafios relacionados à tributação, capital de giro, sazonalidade e gestão operacional.     Se você se identifica com a nossa missão de impactar o mercado de e-commerce e busca crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, queremos conhecer você!   Venha construir o futuro do comércio digital conosco no Grupo Escalada

title: Technical Assistant
description:

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF’s technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date.   Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements.   Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person.   Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance.   Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers’ sites.   Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation.   Providing technical support to the sales department as needed.   Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects.     What You’ll Bring    Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage.   Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic.   Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. title: Consultor(A) Comercial
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Consultor(A) Comercial em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.    Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em  vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado  , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.    Quem somos e o que fazemos     Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de  soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos  . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.    Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.    O que oferecemos     Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;    Modelo de trabalho híbrido;    Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;    Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;    Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;    Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;    Oportunidadesreais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.     Suas responsabilidades     Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em  desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo  . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:    Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em  vendas complexas e consultivas   ;    Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;    Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;    Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;    Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;    Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;    Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;    Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.     Quem procuramos     Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:    Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;    Capacidade deatuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;    Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;    Habilidade para construir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;    Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório.   Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;    Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;    Graduação completa;    Inglês avançado.     Nosso compromisso com a diversidade     Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.    Faça parte da nossa história     Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Technical Assistant
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Assistant em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability? At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas. DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions. About The Job The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues. Working Tasks and Responsibilities Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF's technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers' sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects.  What You'll Bring Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.  Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together! We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at .

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes:  -  Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  -  Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  -  Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  -  Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  -  Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  -  Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  -  Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  -  Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  -  Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring:  -  At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience  -  Strong Python skills  -  Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3  -  Real production experience with ML on AWS  -  Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning  -  Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data  -  Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content  -  A strong eye for correctness and data quality  -  Business level English  -  The ability to work independently in a small remote team  -  A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions  -  12 month B2B contract  -  Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap  -  Flat structure with direct communication  -  Production product with real users and real data problems  -  Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence  -  Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data architecture  Tech Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you'll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)  What we're looking for Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you'll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours  What's in it for you This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.What You Bring Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.Why Join Us Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.IMPORTANT Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.Compensation:$40-60/hour depending on experience

As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture.
