Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos.A vaga em uma fraseAssistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts.A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro.É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar.Como você vai trabalharVocê será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades.Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos.2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço.3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor.> >> Testeprático (Passo 1)Vídeo de explicação do teste:A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo: -  Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil) -  Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil) -  Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menoresFAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam?O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis).P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação.Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis):Vídeo 1:Vídeo 2:Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação.Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons.Critérios de avaliação: -  Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia -  Título / Headline escrito -  Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait -  Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir -  Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples -  Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruídoReferências de vídeos curtos:> >> Como se candidatar (por e-mail)Envie o teste feito para: - Assunto: Vaga Editor de Vídeo Júnior — (Seu Nome)Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículoPara quem essa vaga não é -  Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo -  Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar -  Quem reage a feedback como ataque -  Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficientePara quem essa vaga é -  Quem está começando mas quer crescer rápido -  Quem topa trabalhar duro para se provar -  Quem quer entrar numa empresa que está construindo algo grande e ter a chance de crescer junto

title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.    This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.    About us    Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.   We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.   The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.    Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.   The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.   This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.    Role description    As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.    Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.   You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.    The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.   You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.    Your work includes:   -  Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection    -  Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats    -  Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production    -  Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases    -  Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value    -  Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling    -  Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time    -  Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS    -  Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows    This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.    Requirements   You bring:   -  At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience    -  Strong Python skills    -  Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3   -  Real production experience with ML on AWS    -  Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning    -  Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data    -  Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content    -  A strong eye for correctness and data quality    -  Business level English    -  The ability to work independently in a small remote team    -  A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership    Conditions    -  12 month B2B contract   -  Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap   -  Flat structure with direct communication   -  Production product with real users and real data problems   -  Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence   -  Compensation based on senior contractor level    The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.    Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars   Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Loyalty Specialist em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About us:    Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?   About you:    This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.    What You’ll Own:    Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.   You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.   Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.   Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.   Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.   Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.   Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.     What We’re Looking For:   5+ years in a customer retention or account management role.  3+ years within a SaaS company.   Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet.   Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.   Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.   Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.   Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.   Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.   Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.   Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). description:

K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF  IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.   We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.   Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.   Position Overview  We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.   This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.   As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.   Responsibilities  The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.   Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.   In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.   Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.   What Makes This Opportunity Different  At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.   Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.   Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.   We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.   Preferred Qualifications  We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.   Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.   Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.   Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.   You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.   Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

- Negociar e gerenciar parcerias estratégicas em nível nacional; - Liderar análises de benchmarking de canais, concorrência e tendências de mercado, propondo melhorias contínuas nas políticas comerciais, programas de incentivo e modelos de atuação; - Definir, implementar esustentar o modelo de governança dos canais de vendas, garantindo clareza de papéis, responsabilidades e limites de atuação; - Desenvolver, revisar egarantir o cumprimento das políticas comerciais aplicáveis aos canais e parceiros, assegurando conformidade com normas internas, contratos e diretrizes da companhia; - Monitorar desvios de conduta, conduzindo planos de correção e, quando necessário, ações disciplinares junto aos liderados e parceiros comerciais.Requisitos- Ensino superior completo; - Experiência sólida em estratégia e gestão de canais de vendas;
